question: Which country was awarded the prestigious International Social Security Association (ISSA) Award for Outstanding Achievement in Social Security 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India was conferred the ISSA Award for Outstanding Achievement in Social Security 2025__ for its exceptional progress in social protection systems.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Union Minister for Labour and Employment, Mansukh Mandaviya__, received the award at the ISSA World Social Security Forum in __Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia__.**
 
• **The award acknowledges India's __transformative e-Shram portal__, which registered over 300 million unorganised sector workers in four years.**
 
• **The __e-Shram portal__ helped expand social security coverage in India from 19% in 2015 to 64.3% in 2025, covering more than __940 million citizens__.**
 
• **India joins a select group of five countries globally to receive this prestigious award since its inception.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Social Security Association (ISSA)**__

 __
 
• ISSA is the world's leading international organization for social security, aimed at promoting social protection systems.
 
• The ISSA award recognizes exceptional global achievements in social security and protection systems.
 
 
 
• **e-Shram Portal**__
 __
 
• Launched to register unorganised sector workers and provide them with access to social security benefits.
 
• Has played a key role in expanding India's social protection coverage in recent years.
 
 
 
• **India's Social Security Progress**__
 __
 
• India's social security coverage has increased significantly, from 19% in 2015 to 64.3% in 2025.
 
• The government's efforts in expanding welfare schemes and digitizing services have made significant progress in providing benefits to citizens.
 
 
 
• **ISSA World Social Security Forum**__
 
 
• The forum is a key global event where countries share best practices and advancements in social security systems.
